items.title: How much of six months of work does unaided memory actually keep?
items.description: In the opening scenario, the manager clearly recalled a flashy demo from two months back but had lost the bug fix, the mentoring conversations, and the three smaller reliability improvements — roughly 1 of the 4 categories of real work that happened over 6 months, about 25%. Drag the slider to see how unaided recall keeps dropping the longer ago the work happened. A brag doc entry written the week the work happened stays at 100% recall, because it was never left to memory in the first place — that's the fixed reference point this curve is falling away from.
items.compute: const recalledWithoutDoc = Math.max(5, Math.round(95 * Math.exp(-params.monthsAgo / 4.49))); return { recalledWithoutDoc };
